cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Will you put your club captaincy on the rematch?

mechanism: A challenges its former club pupil captain to put actual office on a rematch, using inconclusive pride games to demand an outcome with visible consequences.
confusable: Not simply provoking competitive feeling: A seeks a specific higher loss that neither participant can later dismiss.
comparison: Domestic time at stake versus public leadership and trophy authority.
